chapters.title: The Familiar Face
chapters.content: First day of B.Tech. I was sent from Section A to Section C and, after a lot of confusion, finally landed in Section B. Sitting in the front bench, I looked back and saw a familiar face I hadn't seen in years—Hansini, my friend from Lotus Lap Public School. A small wave became the beginning of everything.

chapters.title: Taking The Empty Seat
chapters.content: I almost stayed where I was. Walking across the classroom felt impossible for an introvert like me. But that day I stood up, walked over, and sat beside her. Looking back, it was one of the best decisions I ever made.

chapters.title: The Trio Is Born
chapters.content: One ordinary lunch break changed everything. Vaish joined us, conversations became longer, laughter became louder, and before we knew it, our trio had been formed.

chapters.title: Notes, Assignments & Rescues
chapters.content: If I missed notes, she wrote them. If I was sleepy, she quietly continued my classwork. Assignments, records, and last-minute submissions somehow always found a way to get done because we helped each other through it all.

chapters.title: Our Favorite Spot
chapters.content: Among all the places in college, one little spot became ours. It gave us our favorite picture too—the three of us standing together, backs turned to the camera, arms around each other. A simple photo that somehow captured an entire friendship.

chapters.title: Late-Night SOS Team
chapters.content: Deadlines. Assignments. Semester stress. Panic before exams. Through every late-night text and call, we reminded each other that we'd survive one more day.

chapters.title: Study Buddy Forever
chapters.content: We weren't just friends. We were teammates. When one of us struggled, the other stepped in. Every semester felt a little easier because neither of us had to face it alone.

chapters.title: The Golden Birthday
chapters.content: After all the memories, all the semesters, all the laughter, and all the chaos, here we are. Another chapter begins.
